title: Won with a local-business edge, subcontracted to its own affiliate
question: When a certified prime wins on bid price or a local-business discount, is the certified subcontractor on its team its own recorded affiliate?
finding: 5 contracts in the bid-sheet screens were won by a prime whose recorded affiliate is the certified local subcontractor on the same team; 1 of these was awarded inside a local-business bid discount rather than to the lowest bidder ($163,257 above the lowest bid in all). Across the contract file, LAVINA TRUCKING, INC. is listed under its affiliate ESQUIVEL GRADING & PAVING INC on 22 contracts, $5.1 million in listed subcontract shares.
how: Pairs from lbe_fronts "certified local firm on the same contract team as its own recorded affiliate" were joined to the Public Works bid sheets read by overruns "low bid then growth" on the contract title and the winner's name, and to earmarks "recommended bidder was not the lowest" on the bid date and the recommended firm.
limits: The rules let two affiliated firms work together; the restriction concerns whether the subcontractor's share counts toward the contract's local-business goal, which the Contract Monitoring Division's crediting record would show and no file on disk does. A bid discount is a preference set by the Administrative Code. Subcontract shares are as listed in the contract file, not payments.

rows.contract: PW VL PAVE RENOV NO.66 & SWR
rows.discount: won inside the Small-LBE 10% local-business bid discount; lowest bid was Precision Engineering, Inc.
